A: A system where a user query is used to retrieve relevant information from external data sources, which is then incorporated into the LLM's generation of a response.","citationIds":["c1"]},{"text":"Flashcard 2 — Q: When is RAG ideal? A: When the data source has too many records to fit in a single prompt, i.e., the text exceeds the LLM's context window.","citationIds":["c2"]},{"text":"Flashcard 3 — Q: What is vector RAG? A: Conventional RAG that retrieves a set number of records closest to the query in vector space (semantic similarity) using text embeddings.","citationIds":["c2"]},{"text":"Flashcard 4 — Q: How does GraphRAG (Microsoft) contrast with vector RAG? A: GraphRAG can answer queries requiring global sensemaking over the entire data corpus.","citationIds":["c2"]},{"text":"Flashcard 5 — Q: What role do summaries play in Microsoft's GraphRAG? A: It uses summaries over large sections of the data source as a form of \"self-memory\", later used to answer queries.","citationIds":["c2"]},{"text":"Flashcard 6 — Q: How did GraphRAG perform against vector RAG in the Microsoft paper? A: It strongly outperformed vector RAG when using GPT-4 as the LLM.","citationIds":["c1"]},{"text":"Flashcard 7 — Q: Where is GraphRAG available? A: As open-source software from Microsoft, plus extensions in LangChain, LlamaIndex, NebulaGraph, and Neo4J.","citationIds":["c1"]},{"text":"Flashcard 8 — Q: What distinguishes graph-structured data? A: It encodes heterogeneous and relational information through its \"nodes connected by edges\" nature.","citationIds":["c3"]},{"text":"Flashcard 9 — Q: How does GraphRAG differ from RAG in retrieval? A: RAG predominantly uses semantic/lexical similarity search, while GraphRAG captures relational knowledge using graph-based machine learning (e.g., GNNs) and graph/network analysis.","citationIds":["c3"]},{"text":"Flashcard 10 — Q: What are the key components of the holistic GraphRAG framework in the survey? A: Query processor, retriever, organizer, generator, and graph data source.","citationIds":["c4"]},{"text":"Flashcard 11 — Q: Which GraphRAG results were reported in HybridRAG for faithfulness and context precision? A: Faithfulness: GraphRAG and HybridRAG 0.96 vs VectorRAG 0.94; context precision was highest for GraphRAG at 0.96.","citationIds":["c5"]}],"citations":[{"id":"c1","chunkId":"730f1a9f38d16689_c_49909d6a6c4b2105","docId":"730f1a9f38d16689","docTitle":"2404.16130_From_Local_to_Global_A_Graph_RAG_Approach_to_Query_Focused_Summarizati","page":2,"quote":"RAG generally refers to any system where a user query is used to retrieve relevant information from external data sources, whereupon this information is incorporated into the generation of a response"},{"id":"c2","chunkId":"730f1a9f38d16689_c_f33b63884369fa88","docId":"730f1a9f38d16689","docTitle":"2404.16130_From_Local_to_Global_A_Graph_RAG_Approach_to_Query_Focused_Summarizati","page":2,"quote":"RAG is ideal when the total number of records in a data source is too large to include in a single prompt to the LLM"},{"id":"c3","chunkId":"737b0b8fe0aa8459_c_aa4f65623169684a","docId":"737b0b8fe0aa8459","docTitle":"2501.00309_Retrieval_Augmented_Generation_with_Graphs_GraphRAG","page":2,"quote":"graph-structured data encodes heterogeneous and relational information through its intrinsic \"nodes connected by edges\" nature"},{"id":"c4","chunkId":"737b0b8fe0aa8459_c_ae1a85080b0608ff","docId":"737b0b8fe0aa8459","docTitle":"2501.00309_Retrieval_Augmented_Generation_with_Graphs_GraphRAG","page":3,"quote":"a holistic framework of GraphRAG consisting of five key components: query processor, retriever, organizer, generator, and graph data source."},{"id":"c5","chunkId":"ac529ab762fd1672_c_91ccaaf2847d7a42","docId":"ac529ab762fd1672","docTitle":"HybridRAG: Integrating Knowledge Graphs and Vector Retrieval Augmented Generation for Efficient Information Extraction","page":7,"quote":"GraphRAG and HybridRAG demonstrated superior performance, both achieving a score of 0.96, while VectorRAG trailed slightly with a score of 0.94."}]}}}
